recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-tone portrait where a human face is rendered entirely through white stippled dots and grain against a solid, saturated orange background. The features are defined by the density of the white particles, creating a soft-focus, ethereal effect.
coreVisualRelationships: High-density white stippling against a flat orange field
Negative space defining the outer contours of the face
Small geometric icon anchored in the bottom right corner
Textured, grainy highlights versus smooth, solid mid-tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and occupies the majority of the frame, cropped tightly to focus on the eyes, nose, and mouth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bridge of the nose and the eyes serve as the primary focal points due to the highest density of white stippling.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright center of the face, moves outward to the fading stippled edges, and finally rests on the small icon in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid orange background surrounds the face, creating a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value (white) highlights; no mid-tone gradients other than those created by dot density.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to two colors: one vibrant base and one highlight color.

letterConstructionRules: Solid fill with slight internal texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: The plus symbol acts as a logo-mark rather than text.

preserve: The distressed, stamped quality of the symbol

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, grainy texture of the portrait.
If text is added, it should feel tactile and printed.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a face using only white stippling and grain on a solid saturated orange background. The face should emerge from the orange through varying densities of white dots, with the highest density on the nose and forehead.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, white, hand-stamped plus symbol in the bottom right corner, ensuring it has slightly rough edges to match the grainy aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Is the face rendered through stippling rather than solid lines?
Is the icon in the bottom right corner small and distressed?
Is the background a uniform, saturated color?

mustRedesign: Any specific facial features that identify a real person
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no photographic mid-tones are present.
Verify the stippling creates a recognizable face.
Check that the corner icon is not too large.
Confirm the orange is vibrant and not muddy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a high-pass filter to a portrait, convert to a bitmap stipple pattern, and layer as a white mask over a solid saturated color field, finishing with a small distressed geometric mark in the corner.
